newsitems.title: Alexander, Warrior Jar Artisan Keycap has arrived!
newsitems.author: rwaymel
newsitems.contents:
[h3]Always seeking worthy opponents and new challenges to become the mightiest warrior, [b][url=https://bnent.eu/ER_Alexander_Keycap]Alexander is ready to take his place atop your keyboard[/url][/b]. He is the perfect companion for any Tarnished looking to add a little strength, courage, and jar-shaped charm to their setup.

Designed as a 1U keycap (20.61x8.757x26.61mm) for R1 placement, Alexander is compatible with MX-style switches. He is made from a high-quality PU resin using a silicon mold and finished with hand-painted details. 

[url=https://bnent.eu/ER_Alexander_Keycap][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41005067/7c98bf75b7a1989216f85da39ebf3b9f1d0f941e.jpg[/img]
[/url]
[u]Product Features:[/u]
[list]
[*]High-quality PU resin construction
[*]Silicone- molded with hand-painted details
[*]Compatible with MX-style switches
[*]Exclusive to the Bandai Namco Store
[/list]

[b]A warrior through and through, even when the battlefield is on your keyboard. [/b]
Add Alexander to your collection and let him continue his journey toward becoming a mighty warrior, one keystroke at a time.
[/h3]

[i]*This product is available on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, the Middle East, India, and the United States.[/i]

newsitems.title: STARSCOURGE RADAHN JOINS THE ELDEN RING FIGUARTS MINI SERIES
newsitems.author: [BNE] *****
newsitems.contents:
[h2]The roar of the Red Lion echoes to the heavens.[/h2]

He built his might out of love and loyalty, an unstoppable force that bade the stars to halt at the cry of a true champion. And in the Wailing Dunes, the loyalty he shared with others freed him from a fate worse than death.

Now, the power of this greatest of Carian generals can rest in the palm of your hand. Standing [b]12 cm (4.7 in) tall[/b], [i]Starscourge Radahn[/i] is stylized figure that features simple articulation, interchangeable left- and right-hand parts that hold his Starscourge Greatsword, his detachable scrawny steed, and a dedicated display stand.

Produced with the super-deformed proportions of the [b]FIGURARTS Mini series[/b], [i]Starscourge Radahn[/i] is molded from quality PVC and ABS with exact attention to detail paid even at this miniature size. His golden armor, his raging snarl, even the gravity crests on his blades can be made out with perfect clarity.

[b][url=https://bnent.eu/ER_Radahn_Mini_Figuarts]Pre-orders for this charming miniature figure are available now on the Bandai Namco Store[/url][/b]. Do not tary, every other limited edition in this series has sold out.

[i]*This product is available on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, the Middle East, India, and the United States.[/i]

[url=https://bnent.eu/ER_Radahn_Mini_Figuarts][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41005067/8b146f5f8779f9969ff8af4c8e06c0a4076f3ef7.jpg[/img][/url]

newsitems.title: New Elden Ring Mini Replicas Arrive: Malenia, Messmer & Wylder
newsitems.author: [BNE] *****
newsitems.contents:
[h3]Tarnished, collectors, and champions of the Lands Between, we're excited to unveil [url=https://bnent.eu/ER_TrioHelmets][b]a new lineup of premium 1/3 Scale Mini Replicas[/b][/url] inspired by some of the most iconic designs from the Elden Ring universe and crafted by Pure Arts.

From the legendary [b]Blade of Miquella[/b], to the fearsome [b]Messmer the Impaler[/b], and the indominable warriors of Nightreign, these finely crafted collectibles capture the artistry and atmosphere that have made the Elden Ring universe unforgettable.[/h3]

[h3]Elden Ring - Arm of Malenia Mini Replica (1/3 Scale)[/h3]
Celebrate the unmatched elegance and strength of Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with this exquisite 1/3 scale replica of her prosthetic arm from Elden Ring.
Meticulously sculpted and finished, the piece highlights every refined detail - from the intricate golden engravings to the articulated armor plating that defines her graceful yet deadly form.
The arm's metallic sheen and subtle weathering evoke the beauty and ferocity of the demigoddess warrior. Presented on a simple black display base, it offers an elegant way to showcase this symbol of unwavering resolve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41005067/7965bc6558c5efe4232c9ff33b9581d9c3d9450f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Elden Ring - Helmet of Malenia Mini Replica (1/3 Scale)[/h3]
Honor the legacy of Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with this meticulously crafted 1/3 scale replica of her legendary helmet from Elden Ring.
Every detail reflects the beauty and ferocity of the demigoddess warrior, from the intricate engravings to the elegant winged crest that defines her unmistakable silhouette.
The helmet's metallic finish and subtle weathering capture the essence of Malenia, Blade of Miquella's battle-worn armor. Presented on a simple black display stand, it offers an elegant and timeless way to display this symbol of strength and determination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41005067/b193aac64a56b7ed16878748ea1445287bc37ccb.jpg[/img]

[h3]Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree - Helmet of Messmer Mini Replica (1/3 Scale)[/h3]
Embrace the dark majesty of Messmer the Impaler with this finely detailed 1/3 scale replica of his distinctive helmet from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
Sculpted with precision, the piece captures the menacing elegance of Messmer the Impaler's design - from the elongated horns and ornate patterns to the burnished metallic finish that reflects his fiery power.
The helmet's intricate craftsmanship evokes the regal yet fearsome aura of the Impaler himself. Presented on a simple black display stand, it provides a refined presentation worthy of this symbol of divine wrath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41005067/2fb118ac6c76cf50fbee65d937366987a60d4e8a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Elden Ring Nightreign - Helmet of Wylder Mini Replica (1/3 Scale)[/h3]
Enter the shadowed realm of Elden Ring Nightreign with this finely crafted 1/3 scale replica of the Wylder Helmet, an iconic piece of armor worn by the wandering knights of the darkened lands.
This high-quality collectible captures every intricate detail of the original design, from the weathered metallic finish to the subtle engravings that mark its storied past.
The helmet features a fabric neck veil, adding texture and realism to the piece. Presented on a simple black display stand, it offers an elegant way to showcase its imposing form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41005067/2bcca72258e3872e8043aef5a46dcb0b0b5bc175.jpg[/img]

[h3]Expand Your Collection[/h3]
Each of these officially licensed mini replicas has been crafted by Pure Arts to faithfully capture the spirit, craftsmanship, and legendary designs of the Elden Ring universe. Whether your allegiance lies with Malenia, your fascination belongs to Messmer, or you're drawn to the mysteries of Nightreign, these collectibles are the perfect way to bring a piece of the Lands Between to your collection.

[h2][i][b]Which replica will earn a place on your shelf?[/b][/i][/h2]

[i]*This products are available on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, the Middle East, India, and the United States.[/i]

[url=https://bnent.eu/ER_TrioHelmets][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41005067/f06afbb32e108fa4d36f17f8164aebe4a8ba9e21.jpg[/img][/url]

newsitems.title: ELDEN RING - Community Quests
newsitems.author: [BNE] *****
newsitems.contents:
[h2]In celebration of the recently released [b]ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition[/b] for Nintendo Switch and the [b]Tarnished Pack[/b] available, we encourage all Tarnished to return to the lands between and rise together in shared quests to unlock new artwork commemorating each challenge.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41005067/b95536317f443b30a2e0e3af3c674c7faf8c2705.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]Questline 1: Path of the Tarnished[/b][/u][/h3]
[i]Time Period: September 1 - September 28[/i]
[list]
[*] Summon Sorcerer Rogier 300,000 times
[*] Obtain 2,000,000 Stonesword Keys
[*] Obtain 1,500,000 Cookbooks
[*] Obtain 1,000,000 Sacred Tears
[*] [b]Reward: Commemorative Artwork by Shimhaq[/b]
[*] [b]Twitch Chat Badge: Sorcerer Rogier by Carsondrewit[/b]
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Questline 2: Path of the Cardinal Sin[/b][/u][/h3]
[i]Time Period: October 1 - October 28[/i]
[list]
[*] Commit 50,000 Cardinal Sins
[*] Summon 3,000,000 White Phantoms
[*] Obtain 1,000,000 Festering Bloody Fingers
[*] Obtain 3,000,000 Golden Seeds
[*] [b]Reward: Commemorative Artwork to be revealed[/b]
[*] [b]Twitch Chat Badge: Festering Bloody Finger by Carsondrewit[/b]
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Questline 3: Path of the Elden Lord[/b][/u][/h3]
[i]Time Period: November 2 - November 28[/i]
[list]
[*] Summon 50,000 Warrior Jar Alexander
[*] Obtain 3,000,000 Rune Arcs
[*] Obtain 500,000 Legendary Armaments
[*] Upgrade 100,000 Standard Spirit Ashes to +8
[*] [b]Reward: Commemorative Artwork to be revealed[/b]
[*] [b]Twitch Chat Badge: Warrior Jar Alexander by Carsondrewit[/b]
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Questline 4: Path of Shadows[/b][/u][/h3]
[i]Time Period: December 1 - December 28[/i]
[list]
[*] Collect 1,000,000 Scadutree Fragments
[*] Reach the Abyssal Woods 15,000 times
[*] Drink from St. Trina's Nectar 10,000 times
[*] Obtain 70,000 Larval Tears
[*] Obtain 500,000 Revered Spirit Ashes
[*] [b]Reward: Commemorative Artwork to be revealed[/b]
[*] [b]Twitch Chat Badge: St. Trina by Carsondrewit[/b]
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Exclusive Discord Emote Contest[/b][/u]
In addition to the in-game challenges a separate creative contest will be held inside the [b]ELDEN RING Discord Server[/b]!
[url=https://discord.gg/eldenring]For more information join the server here[/url][/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/eldenring][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41005067/4a67aebb0bd12f21d787fef8aa3dd430fe232bc1.png[/img][/url]
